description: Carta de Suscetibilidade a Movimento Gravitacionais de Massa e Inundação - Município de Santa Maria Madalena - RJ (Programa Gestão de Riscos e Respostas a Desastres - Mapeamento Geológico-Geotécnico e is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Documento cartográfico complementar ao Objeto 0602 do Programa de Gestão de Riscos e Resposta a Desastres Naturais, incluído no Plano Plurianual 2012-2015 do Ministério do Planejamento, Orçamento e Gestão. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are risco geológico, carta de suscetibilidade, movimento gravitacionais de massa, deslizamento, corrida de massa e enxurradas. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
